title: Without the invoicing permissions Close Work Order is hidden
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete.
  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'See Financial Data' but not 'Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit', at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The header shows no "Close Work Order", as it would show no "Create invoice".

Step 2:

  • The menu does not offer it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-N3: “If the user does not have 'Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit' and 'See Financial Data', the Close Work Order button is not shown, as Create invoice is not.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions (Action | Needs | Without it): “Close Work Order | 'Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit' and 'See Financial Data' | Button and action hidden, as Create invoice (S3-N3)”
